Reset adopts pendingState.generation without independently validating the complete original active/pending owner state. Baton due is sampled before Reset, but the actual Reset boundary still uses the obsolete compound result shape and only tBefore. Existing Quiz bounds include the forbidden +800 slack. Native reset reinitializes Quiz at actual activity-clock time with the independently authored five-second deadline; proof requires the full Reset activity interval plus 5000 and positive original pending work across the actual event bracket. Reset has a checkpoint and eventual Quiz terminal validator but no bounded new-expiry crossover; isolation has a checkpoint but no complete legitimate new-generation expiry step. Old-due crossing also uses the obsolete activityNow field.

Do not add slack, sleep, retry or runtime-derived expectation.

componentObservations.observation: The peer path contains an observation-only poll for ended/team-2/position1 before full settled state validation and freezing; it has one native Pass, no added sleep/retry/winner fallback. For the target-one peer, Pass produces waiting/correct=false with batonDue=actual activity time+1200; its first baton awards team-2, ends at both positions {team-1:0,team-2:1}, retains activeTeamId team-1/question-1/turn1/correct=false and clears deadline/batonDue. Complete static settled state is checked after the poll. Peer UI checks only Red:1/1, not both lanes/progress/winner feedback/controls. Leave-return invokes pending or first-settled validators, but pending lacks retained deadline and exact baton due bounds; first-settled checks only deadline type. Target-two first timeout must remain original team/question/turn1 while waiting, then advance team-2 to1 and reactivate team-1/question-1/turn2 with correct/batonDue cleared and a separately bounded new deadline. Full transition timing/uncertainty and UI remain required.

componentObservations.observation: Question Next still passes preconsumed.due (q1's state.deadline) as originalRoundDue. The real authored round is 30 seconds and q1/q2 are five seconds; native Next creates q2 deadline=min(retained roundDeadline,native Next activity time+5000), later than q1 expiry on the intended transition. The validator's <=originalRoundDue therefore rejects the correct owner. The retained round due must be independently validated/preserved by equality, while the native Next result supplies the separate next-question deadline interval. Do not relax the assertion or recategorize R16 as LOC.

Round-expiry Next expects error=null and questionDeadline=null, but nextRound's exhausted-round branch spreads the review object and changes only phase,deadline,roundDeadline,winnerId. It retains error='Time expired.', finite original questionDeadline and startedAt, with tied-zero winner team-1. The presenter gives retained error precedence over winner text. Current immutable oracle therefore contradicts the real owner. Preserve exact retained identities/history/scores/awards/clocks and owner feedback rather than inventing a clearing transition.

Question/round expiry and Next have improved complete key/static identity checks, but retained clock values and independently bounded next-question policy are not fully checked, and corresponding native UI is not asserted. Trivia peer checks the two exact awards, both scores and identities but not all four independently native-bounded clocks before freezing. A retained review deadline is data, not outstanding work: the presenter schedules only active states. Required complete expiry/Next/peer meaning is unchanged.

NF_A4Scope.completeRecordedMechanismVerbatim: evaluateActionCandidates returns candidates from the public, replaceable window.__nsRecordedPackets (:146-147). storeHealth (:148) checks only the lifecycle store. In-place mutation of an original packet is detected, because that packet object is also the retained native-action detail. Replacing the array, or replacing an element with a forged object, leaves the retained and private stores untouched, so health stays true. extractActionBracket (observation.js:107-131) then builds the action bracket from the forged packet: rootEventsBefore/After, stateAfter and tCapture/tBubble, which witness.js:44-63 adopts as the Start baseline. This is the same public-store replacement model as N07-04, applied to the packet store.
